doc_title: Hollisbrook Venn Wealth Partners, LLC Compliance Policies and Procedures Manual
notes: All six modifications are small in-place edits (a dollar threshold and a deadline number each buried inside a long paragraph, may to shall, a consent right moving from the Compliance Committee to the CCO, an inserted 'or oral', a carve-out appended to the ETF exemption), mixed among six non-material edits that include a renamed defined term and a cross-reference renumbered only because the confidentiality section moved. The removed gift-log exception leaves the neighbouring gift sections byte-identical, and the unchanged Electronic Communications section invites an invented change next to the new off-channel policy.

changes.description: The dollar ceiling on the pre-clearance exemption for same-day trades in common stock of issuers with a market capitalization of at least $10 billion was lowered from $25,000 to $10,000.
changes.prior_quote: aggregated with all other same-day transactions in that issuer across the Access Person's Covered Accounts, does not exceed $25,000.
changes.current_quote: aggregated with all other same-day transactions in that issuer across the Access Person's Covered Accounts, does not exceed $10,000.

changes.description: A carve-out was added to the exchange-traded fund exemption: ETFs seeking a leveraged or inverse multiple of the daily return of an index are no longer exempt and now require pre-clearance.
changes.prior_quote: (c) purchases and sales of shares of exchange-traded funds; and
changes.current_quote: (c) purchases and sales of shares of exchange-traded funds, other than an exchange-traded fund that seeks a leveraged or inverse multiple of the daily return of an index; and

changes.description: The Code of Ethics quarterly transaction report deadline was shortened from thirty (30) to fifteen (15) calendar days after the end of each calendar quarter.
changes.prior_quote: a quarterly transaction report no later than thirty (30) calendar days after the end of each calendar quarter
changes.current_quote: a quarterly transaction report no later than fifteen (15) calendar days after the end of each calendar quarter

changes.description: Reimbursement of client losses caused by trade error corrections changed from discretionary (the Firm may reimburse) to mandatory (the Firm shall reimburse).
changes.prior_quote: If correction of a trade error results in a loss, the Firm may reimburse the affected client account for the amount of the loss
changes.current_quote: If correction of a trade error results in a loss, the Firm shall reimburse the affected client account for the amount of the loss

changes.description: The definition of complaint was expanded from written statements only to written or oral statements, bringing oral complaints within the one-business-day reporting and complaint log requirements.
changes.prior_quote: A "complaint" is any written statement of a client or a person acting for a client alleging a grievance
changes.current_quote: A "complaint" is any written or oral statement of a client or a person acting for a client alleging a grievance

changes.description: The approval authority for outside business activities moved from the Compliance Committee to the CCO.
changes.prior_quote: No Supervised Person may engage in any outside business activity without the prior written approval of the Compliance Committee.
changes.current_quote: No Supervised Person may engage in any outside business activity without the prior written approval of the CCO.

changes.description: New off-channel communications policy limiting written business communications to Approved Channels (Firm email, client portal, archived messaging on Firm-issued devices, approved social media accounts), prohibiting personal email, personal texts, WhatsApp, Signal and personal social media, and requiring any off-channel business message received to be preserved and reported to the CCO within one business day, with quarterly certification.
changes.current_quote: Business communication through any other channel, including personal email, text messages from a personal number, WhatsApp, Signal and personal social media accounts (an "Off-Channel Communication"), is prohibited

changes.description: New incident response program under amended Regulation S-P requiring notice to affected individuals as soon as practicable and no later than 30 days after the Firm becomes aware of unauthorized access, and service provider notice to the Firm within 72 hours of a breach.
changes.current_quote: the Firm notifies each affected individual as soon as practicable, and no later than thirty (30) days after becoming aware that unauthorized access has occurred or is reasonably likely to have occurred

changes.current_heading: 7.3 Diminished Capacity and Trusted Contact Persons
changes.description: New procedure requiring wealth advisors to request a trusted contact person from each natural person client at account opening and each annual review, and requiring escalation of suspected diminished capacity or financial exploitation to the CCO within one business day.
changes.current_quote: wealth advisors must ask each client who is a natural person to name a trusted contact person

changes.description: The exception from Gift Log recording for logo promotional items under $50, shared perishable food and modest seminar or due diligence meals was deleted, so every gift and entertainment event must now be logged under Section 3.2.
changes.prior_quote: Notwithstanding Section 3.2, a Supervised Person need not record on the Gift Log (a) promotional items bearing the giver's logo

changes.prior_heading: 1.2 Designation and Duties of the Chief Compliance Officer
changes.current_heading: 1.2 Designation and Duties of the Chief Compliance Officer
changes.description: The sentence on delegation of compliance functions was reworded; the CCO may still delegate and still retains responsibility.
changes.prior_quote: The CCO may delegate the performance of specific compliance functions to other Supervised Persons, but the CCO retains responsibility for each delegated function.
changes.current_quote: Although the CCO may delegate the performance of specific compliance functions to other Supervised Persons, responsibility for each delegated function remains with the CCO.

changes.description: The boilerplate last-review date was rolled forward from February 2025 to August 2026.
changes.prior_quote: reviewed by the CCO and approved by the Management Committee in February 2025.
changes.current_quote: reviewed by the CCO and approved by the Management Committee in August 2026.

changes.prior_quote: Partially filled orders are allocated pro rata accross participating accounts
changes.current_quote: Partially filled orders are allocated pro rata across participating accounts

changes.description: The prohibition on destroying, altering or discarding Firm records was reworded with identical meaning.
changes.prior_quote: Supervised Persons must not destroy, alter or discard any Firm record except in accordance with this Section.
changes.current_quote: No Supervised Person may destroy, alter or discard any Firm record other than as this Section permits.

changes.prior_heading: 6.1 Privacy and Safeguarding of Customer Information
changes.current_heading: 6.1 Privacy and Safeguarding of Customer Information
changes.description: Cross-reference renumbered from Section 1.4 to Section 6.2 to follow the relocated confidentiality section.
changes.prior_quote: must also observe the confidentiality obligations in Section 1.4.
changes.current_quote: must also observe the confidentiality obligations in Section 6.2.

changes.description: The defined term BCP Coordinator was renamed Continuity Lead consistently throughout the section; the role is still held by the Chief Operating Officer with the same duties.
changes.prior_quote: The Chief Operating Officer serves as business continuity coordinator (the "BCP Coordinator").
changes.current_quote: The Chief Operating Officer serves as business continuity lead (the "Continuity Lead").

changes.description: The confidentiality section was relocated without change from Section 1 (1.4) to Section 6 (6.2).
changes.prior_quote: Client information may be used only to service the client and may be disclosed only (a) to Supervised Persons who need it
changes.current_quote: Client information may be used only to service the client and may be disclosed only (a) to Supervised Persons who need it
